text:
Marta: quick check — ACME enterprise asked for per-tenant routing in MVP, citing predictable latency for their tenants. want to know tradeoffs and a firm rec by EOD.
Jong: short answer: it’s doable but impacts runtime changes and adds ~3–4 weeks of infra work + extra testing. also increases e2e matrix.
Li: perf data from the prototype: routing shard adds ~12% p95 latency on our current batching shape when tenant affinity is enforced.
Sam: from UX: if we defer, we can ship a single routing experience and offer a guidance doc + rollout plan for customers who need strict isolation.
Evan: customer success note — ACME can accept a canary in 1 region for now, but their legal team prefers isolation in contract for Q2.
Marta: ok. alternatives? feature-sliced approach? partial routing?
Jong: we could do lightweight routing (header-based) that doesn’t change the KV cache layout. less ideal but 1 week work and lower perf hit (~3% p95).
Li: important: header-based still leaves some cross-tenant cache interference, so strict isolation -> full tenant routing required.
Sam: we could mark strict isolation as "v1 enterprise feature" in docs and offer an interim opt-in beta with caveats.
Marta: what about risk to launch timeline if we include full routing in MVP?
Jong: risk: +3–4 weeks, CI flakiness surface, need extra load testing, and SRE runbook updates. could jeopardize planned marketing demo.
Evan: contract-wise we can commit to roadmap milestone for v1 and offer priority engineering for ACME if they sign a pilot addendum.
Marta: proposal: ship MVP without full per-tenant routing, implement header-based interim for high-priority pilots, and schedule full routing for v1. update ACME with pilot addendum option.
Jong: +1. I’ll scope the header-based change and put a short spike on Monday. estimate in PRD by Tue.
Li: I’ll run a targeted perf run on header-based approach today and drop numbers in the doc.
Sam: I’ll draft the customer-facing note with caveats and demo screenshots.
Evan: I’ll prepare the pilot addendum template and talk to legal.
deploy-bot: scheduled: roadmap-update-doc pushed to staging at 1756790000 :white_check_mark:
Marta: thanks team — decision stands. I’ll update roadmap and notify ACME. Action owners: Jong (implementation spike), Li (perf), Sam (customer note), Evan (pilot addendum). Will sync Fri for status.
